verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Justworks collects W-4 filing/withholding info automatically during employee enrollment, avoiding manual W-4 filing (justworks-docs-7, justworks-docs-22), and describe an onboarding/enrollment timeline (justworks-docs-33). However, there is no explicit documentation of an I-9 collection step or bank/direct-deposit detail capture within a self-serve pre-day-one flow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of I-9 verification workflow, bank account/direct deposit collection, and confirmation that this is bundled into a single self-serve new-hire flow completed before day one.
